text:
ria: quick note  I opened PR #4412 to refresh the quickstart (auth + first deploy). Main goals: pick a single env var, update Node example to new SDK shape, add a one-liner Docker run, and fix two broken links. Pls skim.

ben: thanks, will review. which env var are we standardizing on?

ria: REDWOOD_API_KEY. added a tiny "if you're on LEGACY_TOKEN" migration tip and a one-liner snippet showing how to set it in CI.

kyle: can you paste the Node snippet here so I can check the return structure and clean-up?

ria: yep, from the PR:

```
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Hello from quickstart' });
console.log(resp.output.text); // output has text + tokens + meta
await client.close(); // avoid open handles in tests
```

ben: looks good. note: use `resp.output.text` in examples (we standardized `output`). also mention minimum Node 18.

ria: added Node 18 min note and a comment on loading .env in dev. removed streaming from the main snippet and put a short appendix link for streaming examples.

kyle: Docker check: include build + run example with env injection, like `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY hello-quickstart`. keep it simple for workshops.

ria: added a one-line Docker command and a very small Dockerfile example in the README.

ben: a couple of link fixes: private-deploy link was 404 and our KMS link pointed to an internal draft. I've pasted the corrected URLs in the PR comment.

kyle: can we add a brief troubleshooting bullet: 401 -> check token env + ensure org policy allows API access? saves a lot of questions.

ria: added a short troubleshooting list and a "rotate tokens" curl example for ephemeral tokens. left enterprise KMS details as a link to private docs.

docs-bot: PR #4412 labeled docs/quickstart and assigned to ria.

ria: thanks. ben/kyle can you both give a quick thumbs within the hour so I can merge before tomorrow's onboarding run? :pray:
